symbols.name: ground set size
symbols.meaning: The number of elements of the ground set $[h]$.
symbols.quote: Let $[h]=\{1,\dots,h\}$ be the ground set, where $h$ is the number of its elements.

symbols.name: triple family
symbols.meaning: The set of all three-element subsets of the ground set.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal T$ be the set of three-element subsets of $[h]$, and write $S,T\in\mathcal T$ for triples.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set, one element of the triple family.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal T$ be the set of three-element subsets of $[h]$, and write $S,T\in\mathcal T$ for triples.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set, one element of the triple family.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal T$ be the set of three-element subsets of $[h]$, and write $S,T\in\mathcal T$ for triples.

symbols.name: first bank
symbols.meaning: The bank of scalars $x_S$, one for each triple $S$.
symbols.quote: Write $X$ and $Y$ for the two banks, which hold a scalar $x_S$ and a scalar $y_S$ for each triple $S$, and $x_T$ is the same family indexed by $T$.

symbols.name: second bank
symbols.meaning: The bank of scalars $y_S$, one for each triple $S$.
symbols.quote: Write $X$ and $Y$ for the two banks, which hold a scalar $x_S$ and a scalar $y_S$ for each triple $S$, and $x_T$ is the same family indexed by $T$.

symbols.name: ground element
symbols.meaning: An element of the ground set, indexing one central wire.
symbols.quote: Each element $g\in[h]$ has a central wire $C_g$, and the complex version adds one more central wire $C_\ast$.

symbols.name: side wire
symbols.meaning: The scratch wire attached to an ordered neighbouring pair of triples.
symbols.quote: Each ordered neighbouring pair $(S,T)$ has a side wire $A_{ST}$.

symbols.name: central wire
symbols.meaning: The scratch wire attached to ground element $g$.
symbols.quote: Each element $g\in[h]$ has a central wire $C_g$, and the complex version adds one more central wire $C_\ast$.

symbols.name: extra central wire
symbols.meaning: The additional scratch wire used only in the complex version.
symbols.quote: Each element $g\in[h]$ has a central wire $C_g$, and the complex version adds one more central wire $C_\ast$.

relations.quote: The subset-intersection finite network is built as a [linear network](linear-network.md) that exchanges two banks of scalars indexed by three-element subsets of a ground set.
The complex version takes its scalars from $\mathbb Z[i,1/2]$, the [Gaussian dyadic numbers](gaussian-dyadic.md), and neighbours are distinct triples with even intersection.
